notes.title: Colorless Patch 2.1.8
notes.content:
Welcome to the Third Game Patch!

Major Change :

Something is coming, do you remember ? Yes, you do.

 Other Patch Improvements :

[olist]
 Fixed Act 4 and Secret Acts, due to problems saving/loading in these acts.
 The save system now preserves the rotation of each interactable object.
 Fixed an error that prevented game completion in Act 4.
 The translation didn't work for some ui and messages.
 More adjustments have been made to enhance the legibility of text and dialogues throughout the game.
[/olist]

notes.title: Colorless Patch 2.1.5

notes.title: Colorless Patch 2.1.3
notes.content:
Welcome to the First Game Patch!

We're excited to introduce the very first patch for our game, and it comes packed with some exciting updates and improvements to enhance your gaming experience. Here's what's inside:

Major Change :

Reset Button:
Your memory may still be hazy after your head injury, but some parts are starting to resurface. Introducing a new, peculiar button that will come to your aid during your adventure. Use it to reset the entire puzzle if you ever find yourself stuck.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43337355/7699f8b2fca6b8db70588bfe067250a15c2bdf04.png

German Language:
Your head must be throbbing with pain; not only are you seeing French and English sentences, but now German as well!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43337355/b3fd43dc46b65be03aa6922d0e0069ed654f4ca8.png

 Other Patch Improvements :

[olist]
 Several dialogues have been revised for enhanced clarity and coherence.
 Glass elements in the game have been optimized for improved visibility.
 Various adjustments have been made to enhance the legibility of text and dialogues throughout the game.
[/olist]

Thank you for being part of our gaming community, and we hope you enjoy these enhancements in your gaming journey ! See you again this month !

notes.title: What will come this september ?
notes.content:
First of all, I want to express my heartfelt gratitude for your unwavering support since the very beginning of our game's journey. It may feel like a small community, but your enthusiasm and feedback mean the world to me, especially considering that this is my very first game. As I eagerly anticipate the upcoming reviews and reflect on the insights gathered during private testing, I'm thrilled to share a sneak peek of the exciting updates I have in store for this September.

My dedication to enhancing your gaming experience has been my driving force, and I've been listening attentively to your comments and suggestions. Here's a glimpse of the player-centric improvements that are on the horizon:


NEXT WEEK (4/09/2023 - 10/09/2023) : 

 A reset button to put everything back in place even if a game bug has occurred.
 A more efficient way of viewing in-game dialogues because the background can make it hard to read.
 A few dialogue corrections and rewriting
 Make the windows less clean in the lab (some thought it was an open path lol)
 Searching for the missing chicken that escaped the museum


THIS MONTH

 A save system, the game was originally designed to be finished in one go, but this doesn't fit in with the "playable by everyone" principle of the game, so I'm going to work on it and at least try to present it this month, otherwise a simple version will be made until I can present you with a complete version.
 I've been in touch with a cool guy (hey qubodup !) who's volunteered to add the German language in colorless, which will be accompanied by a change to the dialog font due to the characters used.
 I'm working on making the game more polished and on the design, which is sometimes not too logical between the acts. The game was originally made as a single project with act 0, which is the original act, and this can be seen because of the model used in the intro and act 0, which are different in some ways.


This September updates marks just the beginning of my commitment to continuous improvement. Your feedback continues to be my guiding light, and I'm truly thankful for your ongoing support. Keep an eye out for more details and release notes as we approach the update's launch. Together, we're shaping an exciting journey, and I couldn't do it without you. Thank you for being a part of this unique gaming experience!

Radcoon
